remarks: Standalone 3 Room Office with walk up attic (partially finished) on high trafficked Long Ridge Rd. Position your business in a polished, turnkey office with exceptionally low overhead and predictable monthly costs. This 1,072 SF office space is designed for operators who want to focus on their business-not building management-just minutes from downtown and easy access to the Merritt Parkway. Featuring three hard-walled private offices, a full kitchen, and a private 1/2 bathroom. Ground-level access and 10 dedicated off-street parking spaces further enhance usability for both clients and staff. Cost efficiency is a core advantage. The modified-gross lease includes water, property taxes, insurance, common area maintenance, landscaping & snow removal. Tenants are responsible only for separately metered electric. High traffic location with strong regional access, and hands-off ownership make this a low-stress, high-efficiency workspace rarely available at this price point.
